label: Will: possession, two-way rational giving, and actual rational giving
resolution: WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_1 is HAS_WILL_1, possession of will, as used in STMT-GOD-HAS-WILL. WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_2 (WilledTwoWayAt) is rational giving with withholding at an accessible world where the giver exists with the same set-up. WILL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_WILLED_GIVING_3 (RationallyGivesAt) is the actual giving of a specified effect by an owned rational power at the selected world. The fixed-output control in ThroughWill satisfies sense 3 while lacking the possible withholding of sense 2. The capacity-to-exercise applications require explicit premises, including the prior-intellect or one-power routes for the qualifying universal giver. The open bridge 65e0179f-55d4-4b77-98ba-4b5b26f2d404 licenses the move from ownership of a rational power to HAS_WILL_1. Bridge 71fc097b-4039-4812-a498-2ad70fe08b98 licenses the reverse move from HAS_WILL_1 to ownership of a rational power. They concern possession. Actual exercise and same-set-up withholding require further inputs in the will-versus-chance batch. Ownership of a rational power remains unbridged to the possessed appetitive power of 941efd70-d56f-53f9-b5f9-8acd36711a54. Recipient-directed willing in a94c5dfc has a separate application premise from sense 3 and receives no definition from either giving sense.
